body:
## Goal
Provide a dependency-free Node.js HTTP server that answers GET / with an HTML "Hello, World!" page, so the project has a runnable baseline entry point.

## Spec
Built on Node's built-in `node:http` (ESM `import`, no Express/Fastify/etc.). Server binds to `process.env.PORT` when set, else 3000. A `GET /` request returns HTTP status 200, header `Content-Type: text/html`, and a body containing the exact substring `Hello, World!`. The `PORT` default and the status/Content-Type/body contract on `GET /` are load-bearing (the acceptance criteria assert them); other request methods/paths are unconstrained by this Story. `package.json` declares `"type": "module"` and a `"start"` script that launches the single source file via `node`. Implementation footprint is exactly one source file plus `package.json`.

## Changes
- `server.js` — creates
- `package.json` — refactors-existing

## Acceptance
- [ ] AC-1: `server.js` exists as an ESM module that uses only Node built-ins (no non-builtin import specifiers) and starts an HTTP server.
- [ ] AC-2: The server listens on `process.env.PORT` when set and on port 3000 when it is unset.
- [ ] AC-3: A `GET /` request receives HTTP 200 with a `Content-Type` header of `text/html` and a response body containing the exact text `Hello, World!`.
- [ ] AC-4: `package.json` sets `"type": "module"` and defines a `"start"` script that launches `server.js` with `node`.
- [ ] AC-5: The implementation footprint is exactly one source file (`server.js`) plus `package.json` — no additional source files and no runtime dependencies.

## Verify
- PORT=3100 node server.js & SVR=$!; sleep 1; curl -sD - http://localhost:3100/ -o /tmp/hw-body.txt | grep -i '^HTTP/1.1 200' && curl -sD - http://localhost:3100/ -o /dev/null | grep -i '^Content-Type: text/html' && grep -q 'Hello, World!' /tmp/hw-body.txt; kill $SVR (e2e)
- node -e "import('node:child_process'); const {execSync}=require('node:child_process')" 2>/dev/null; node --check server.js (validate)
- node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); if(p.type!=='module'||!p.scripts||!p.scripts.start){process.exit(1)}" (validate)

## Non-Goals
- Routing framework or middleware layer
- Handling of paths/methods other than GET /
- TLS/HTTPS, logging infrastructure, or graceful-shutdown handling
- Test framework dependencies beyond what ships with Node
